description: Marketplace escrow: an agent buys from a seller. Refund if no carrier-attested shipment by shipBy; release after inspectBy if shipped and undisputed; disputes ruled live (full refund or full release) by an accredited arbiter, bond to the winner. No arbiter-silent defaults; the ruling deadline only raises an ops alert, which repeats until the account closes.

release.confirm.description: The buyer confirms receipt: the seller is paid the price less the fee; anything extra goes back to the buyer.

refund.agreed.description: Buyer and seller cancel (for example before shipping): everything goes back to the buyer.

dispute.refund.description: The arbiter rules for the buyer and signs with the buyer: everything, bond included, back to the buyer. The co-signer is not involved.

dispute.release.description: The arbiter rules for the seller and signs with the seller: the price less the fee, plus the dispute bond (bond to the winner), to the seller. The co-signer is not involved.

default.refund.description: The seller never recorded a shipment by shipBy: everything goes back to the buyer automatically.

default.release.description: Shipped, and nobody disputed by inspectBy: the seller is paid the price less the fee automatically (account holds exactly the price).

default.releaseSweep.description: The same release, signed a second time for when the account holds more than the price: the extra goes back to the buyer. The co-signer completes whichever version fits the balance.

shipBy.description: Fixed at open: the named carrier attester must record the shipment (shipping.shipped/1) by this time.

inspectBy.description: Fixed at open: the buyer must dispute by this time; after it, a recorded shipment with no open dispute releases to the seller.

rulingDueBy.description: Arbiter SLA for ruling on an open dispute. Expiry raises a RULING_OVERDUE ops alert that repeats until the account is deleted; it moves no money, and a later ruling is still accepted (dispute.lateRuling = accept).
